items.desc: Nigerian official faints after being questioned about missing funds — and the timing is what made this go viral worldwide. It's a live hearing in Abuja, BREAKING NEWS on the screen, the committee is questioning Pondei over N82.9 billion paid to a group associated with the Niger Delta. The questions get serious, the camera is rolling, and then he just slumps forward, head down on the desk. Everyone in the room rushes in. Men in suits and masks are holding his shoulders, trying to lift his head, trying to help him. And then the "first aid" starts — and that's the part everyone is talking about.

In this investigation, Miss Media unpacks the connections between Tamryn Raju, her late father Elvis Raju, tow-truck businessman Bevan Loftus and Clive Naicker, whose testimony before the Madlanga Commission brought renewed attention to allegations surrounding the killing of five men in Durban. We examine: • Why did she challenge allegations that Bevan Loftus killed her father? •

cm.t: Who do you think should answer the most pressing questions surrounding Tamryn Raju's murder? Do you think she was killed because of her TikToks?
cm.ko: 타머린 라주의 살인과 관련된 가장 중요한 질문에 누가 답해야 한다고 생각하십니까? 그녀의 틱톡 영상 때문이라고 생각하시나요?

cm.t: Problem here is criminals against criminals
cm.ko: 여기서 문제되는 점은 범죄자가 또 다른 범죄자를 범죄시키는 것이다.

cm.t: This thing is a liar !!! My Pastor and best friend was killed by tow truck guys on the N2. They pay boys from the informal settlements to throw rocks at moving cars and one rock went through my Pastors windscreen and when I got to the accident scene he told me what happened. By the time I got there two tow trucks Indian drivers were there already on the scene . My Pastor died three hours later fro
cm.ko: 이것은 거짓말입니다! 제 목사님과 가장 친한 친구는 N2 고속도로에서 트럭 운전자가 고성을 지르며 공격하여 사망했습니다. 그들은 비공식 지역 주민들에게 고를 던져 움직이는 차량을 공격하도록 시키고, 그 중 하나가 제 목사님의 앞 유리에 박혔습니다. 제가 현장으로 도착했을 때, 그는 당시 상황을 설명해 주었습니다.

cm.t: Tamryn knew a lot about the goings on in the tow trucking and drug world, she knew that her cousin is not a good person. She was taken out and Clive Naicker knows all about her death. He is a ruthless LIAR with corrupt cops on his payroll
cm.ko: 타머인은 트럭 운송 및 마약 세계의 상황에 대해 잘 알고 있었으며, 그녀의 사촌이 좋은 사람이 아니라는 것을 알았다. 그녀의 죽음에 대해 클라이브 나이커는 모든 것을 알고 있으며, 그는 부패한 경찰을 고용하고 있는 냉혹한 거짓말쟁이다.
